title: Three Days and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 灾害应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 灾害应对（人与自然·灾害防范·灾害与应对）
meta: 主题语境：灾害应对（人与自然·灾害防范·灾害与应对）　|　核心词汇：injury　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 injury 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the rescuer ① dressed the injury that no survivor in the site would have recorded, and he said the dressing was the whole of the week. The ② injury, meaning the bruise itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a injury, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ injury in that site had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ injury at the far door, meaning the cut they kept for the children to see and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A injury, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the rescuer said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the injury was the whole of the matter, meaning the cost and not the bruise. The ⑥ injury, meaning the cost and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; injury, he said, is either something you dress or the only word that means both a bruise and a cost. He said the cost is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ injury had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ injury of the whole thing, the rescuer wrote in April, was one site and three weeks of recording; injury, he said, is either the cut at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ injury I remember is the bruise recorded in the report, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ injury, my mother said in 1988, is the only bruise that improves by being recorded; every injury, she said, is a cost that has agreed to look like a bruise. She said the cost was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 伤；损害（指现场里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 伤；损害（指那处伤处本身，与绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：dress the injury 包扎这处伤
D. n. 伤；损害（指留给孩子们看的那一处那一处）
E. n. 救援之事（抽象总称，指一处现场的伤之事）
F. n. 伤；损害（指报告里写到、被记下的的那一处）
G. n. 代价、教训（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 教训（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dressed the injury that no survivor in the site would have recorded
The injury, meaning the bruise itself and not the bandage
the injury at the far door
the injury was the whole of the matter
the injury had become a line in a report
The injury of the whole thing
A injury, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: dress the injury 意为“包扎这处伤”，1979 年那位救援员把现场里没有一位幸存者肯记录的一处伤做了一遍。
injury 意为“伤；损害”，指那处伤处本身而不是绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
injury 意为“伤；损害”，指现场里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
injury 意为“伤；损害”，指最远那个门口留给孩子们看的那一处那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
injury 意为“代价、教训”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个代价就是那件事的全部。
injury 意为“教训”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处伤处，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
injury 意为“伤；损害”，指报告里写到、被记下的的那一处，到 1984 年这一处成了报告里的一行。
injury 意为“救援之事”，救援员四月写道，整件事的伤之事是一处现场和三个星期的记录。
injury 意为“伤；损害”，我记得的是报告里记录过的那一处，1986 年痊愈了，至今仍被说成现场里最安静的一处。
injury 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，伤是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的伤处。
